content.text: Senior software engineer with 10+ years of full-stack experience. Strong background in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and team leadership. Passionate about developer experience and platform engineering.

Staff Engineer at BigCo (2020–Present). Led platform architecture for a Kubernetes-based service mesh serving 10M+ requests/day. Reduced infrastructure costs by 40% through workload right-sizing. Mentored 12 engineers across 3 teams.
Senior Engineer at Acme Corp (2017–2020). Built microservice migration framework. Designed CI/CD pipelines adopted across 50+ repos. Shipped customer-facing analytics dashboard serving 100K DAU.

Software Engineer at StartupX (2015–2017). Core backend developer on a real-time collaboration platform. Built WebSocket infrastructure handling 50K concurrent connections. Implemented end-to-end encryption for document sharing.
Junior Developer at WebShop Inc (2013–2015). Maintained e-commerce platform. Fixed bugs and wrote unit tests. Contributed to frontend redesign in React.
Languages: TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, Rust. Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, GCP. Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka. Tools: React, Node.js, GraphQL, gRPC.
Open source contributor to Kubernetes, Envoy, and Terraform. Author of 'go-resilience' library (2K GitHub stars). Conference speaker at KubeCon, QCon, and Strange Loop.
M.S. Computer Science, Stanford University (2013). B.S. Computer Engineering, UC Berkeley (2011).
Engineering blog author (50+ articles). Founded internal mentorship program adopted company-wide. Volunteer coding instructor at local high school.
